caption: A bottle pours orange juice through a visible stream into a glass until the bottle holds less and the glass holds more.

clauses.text: The bottle must be held at an angle to allow the orange juice to flow out.
The stream of orange juice must be visible as it moves from the bottle into the glass.
The level of orange juice in the bottle must visibly decrease as the glass fills.
The glass must visibly increase in liquid volume as it receives the poured juice.
